lang.label: Language
hero.title: Discover the Soul of Japan
hero.sub: Tailor-made journeys from Tokyo's neon streets to Kyoto's quiet temples — planned by local experts who call Japan home.
intro.title: Travel Japan with people who call it home
intro.body: TM Travel is a registered travel agency based in Matsuyama, Ehime, on the island of Shikoku. For years we have guided Japanese travelers across the country and around the world — now we open our doors to guests from abroad.
intro.body2: From iconic sights to hidden local gems, we design every itinerary around you: your pace, your interests, your Japan.
f1.d: Insider knowledge of every region, from big cities to quiet countryside towns.
f2.d: Private and small-group itineraries built around your interests and budget.
f3.d: Friendly help before and during your trip, so you can travel with confidence.
f4.d: Hotels, rail passes, transfers and guides — all handled in one place.
dest.title: Where will Japan take you?
dest.sub: Ten unforgettable places we love to share with first-time visitors and returning travelers alike.
seasons.title: Every season, a different Japan
seasons.sub: Japan's four distinct seasons each bring their own colors, festivals and flavors. Choose yours.
exp.title: Moments you'll carry home
exp.sub: Go beyond sightseeing and experience the traditions, flavors and nature that make Japan unique.
cta.title: Your Japan story starts here
cta.body: Tell us how you dream of traveling. Our team will craft an itinerary made just for you.
step1.d: Dates, interests, group size and travel style.
step2.d: A personalized itinerary with transparent pricing.
step3.d: We take care of the details while you enjoy Japan.
meta.description: Tailor-made journeys across Japan — Tokyo, Kyoto, Mt. Fuji, Hokkaido, Okinawa and more — planned by TM Travel, a travel agency based in Matsuyama, Ehime.
